scope: One fixed new round; not sequential sampling until agreement passes
cases: one net-long, one moderate-short (S2 or S3), one extreme-short 2015+
draw: sorted eligible dates, uniform seeded draw within category; seed+i; copied frozen eligibility logic
purpose: focused prospective validation of primary B2/B3/R after low initial AI concordance; not human reliability or arm effect test
collection: one first complete reply per new frozen prompt/product; no answer-quality reruns; preserve refusal and source failures; all24 assigned IDs resolved before review
gate: Primary binary kappa>=0.70 and >=20 jointly scoreable replies. Report component crossing kappas; any below0.70 or undefined requires explicit HOLD/review, no automatic GO or dropped component. No new round automatically if fails. Human validation pending.
dependencies: 24 replies share3 weeks; do not call them24 independent historical weeks. No pilot arm/product effect tests or endpoint selection.
